precedents.summary: Driver detoured 18% without traffic and made an unexplained 5-minute stop; refunded excess distance fare plus 50% base fare.
precedents.reasoning: Deviation exceeded 15% and an unexplained stop was confirmed by GPS dwell time.

precedents.summary: Driver detoured 6% due to a confirmed accident on the expressway; no refund issued.
precedents.reasoning: Deviation was minor and justified by live traffic data.

precedents.summary: Driver took a 12% longer route with no valid reason; refunded excess distance fare only.
precedents.reasoning: Deviation between 5% and 15% with no traffic justification.

precedents.summary: Driver GPS showed arrival 1.1km from pickup and a 2-minute wait; cancellation fee fully refunded.
precedents.reasoning: Driver never arrived within 150 metres of the pickup point.

precedents.summary: Driver arrived on time and waited 6 minutes with documented messages; no-show fee upheld.
precedents.reasoning: Driver satisfied the arrival and wait-time requirements.

precedents.summary: Driver arrived 12 minutes late and cancelled after 3 minutes; cancellation fee refunded.
precedents.reasoning: Driver arrived more than 10 minutes late, voiding the no-show fee.
